title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) active for Week 11
items.desc: Sione Vaki (ankle) is active for Week 11 for the Detroit Lions against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Vaki is good to go after passing through pregame testing on the ankle without any issues, providing head coach Dan Campbell with a complementary option behind RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs out of the Detroit backfield against the Buccaneers Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Audric Estime inactive for Week 11
items.desc: Audric Estime is inactive for Week 11 for the New Orleans Saints against the Chicago Bears according to Ross Jackson.
items.impact: Estime will not suit up after being relegated to a minimal role in the New Orleans backfield in Week 10, with Alvin Kamara and Travis Etienne Jr. handling the backfield touches against the Bears for head coach Kellen Moore Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tommy Tremble (knee) officially active for Week 11
items.desc: Panthers TE Tommy Tremble (knee) is officially active for Week 11.
items.impact: Tremble was limited in practice to close out the week and was deemed questionable to play against the Ravens. Darren Waller is also active for Bryce Young and the Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Darren Waller (knee) officially active for Week 11
items.desc: Panthers TE Darren Waller (knee) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with  the Ravens.
items.impact: Waller was listed as questionable after being limited in practice to close out the week. The Panthers will also have Tommy Tremble active for Bryce Young.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) inactive for Week 11
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) is inactive for Week 11 for the Detroit Lions against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Reed Jr. will be sidelined despite logging limited practices throughout the week, leaving the Lions secondary shorthanded against the Buccaneers Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) active for Week 11
items.desc: Kerby Joseph (knee) is active for Week 11 for the Detroit Lions against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Joseph returns after being sidelined while recovering from a knee injury suffered last season, boosting a Detroit safety group alongside Brian Branch who recently returned from injury as well for head coach Dan Campbell as the defense looks to disrupt a physical Tampa Bay offense Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) officially inactive for Week 11
items.desc: Bills TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is officially inactive for a Week 11 matchup with Miami.
items.impact: Kincaid was considered doubtful to play after being unable to practice all week. Dawson Knox will likely serve as the primary tight end for Josh Allen and the Bills.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) officially active for Week 11
items.desc: Titans WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with Dallas.
items.impact: Tate was listed as questionable but was expected to play based on early reports. Tate is in a plus matchup against a struggling Dallas' defense, if Cam Ward can clean up some inconsistent quarterback play.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Luke Schoonmaker (illness) officially active for Week 11
items.desc: Cowboys TE Luke Schoonmaker (illness) is officially active for a Week 11 matchup with the Titans.
items.impact: Brevyn Spann-Ford will likely serve as the primary tight end for Dallas with Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) inactive. Schoonmaker should fill the TE2 role against the Titans.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Daniel Jones to wait on potential signing with teams
items.desc: Daniel Jones will wait to sign with potential interested teams according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Jones is said to be waiting for the best opportunity for any potential quarterback-needy teams still in playoff contention. The veteran signal-caller disappointed after an impressive 2025-26 season for the Indianapolis Colts prior his release earlier this week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Drake Maye (ankle) to miss at least six weeks
items.desc: Drake Maye (ankle) will miss at least six weeks for the New England Patriots according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Maye will miss extended time after being injured in the first quarter of a Week 10 loss to the Detroit Lions, with quarterback potentially only returning if New England remains in the playoff hunt. Tommy DeVito remains QB1 unless the Patriots look to add to their quarterback room moving forward.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) shut down for remainder of season
items.desc: Alec Pierce (heel) has been shut down for the remainder of the 2026 NFL season. All eyes are now on a healthy return for 2027 to aid a Colts team undergoing vast changes.
items.impact: It was a disappointing season for the veteran wideout, who signed a massive extension with the team this offseason. Things didn't go to plan in 2026, with Pierce getting injured, Daniel Jones regressing, and the team entering a rebuild despite having fewer top picks at their disposal. It's a wise decision to shut Pierce down in a lost season, and he'll become the top WR for whomever is quarterbacking the Colts next season.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Baker Mayfield (foot) will play Sunday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (foot) will return to start at quarterback for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers Sunday according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Mayfield will take the field while fighting through lingering plantar fasciitis, as the veteran signal-caller looks to keep Tampa Bay's NFC South hopes alive while playing though the injury for head coach Todd Bowles, facing a resurgent Detroit Lions defense on the road Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ladd McConkey (back) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (back) is expected to play for the Los Angeles Chargers Sunday according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: McConkey will test out the back during pregame warmups after being limited in practice throughout the week, offering head coach Jim Harbaugh one his more impactful pass-catchers against the New York Jets Sunday.
